entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Diana. How can I help you today?
Yeah, I need to return a pair of cycling shoes. Just give me a return label.
I can certainly help you with that. To pull up your order, could I get your name and order number, please?
Mark Peterson. Order is VF-8675309. Look, I'm busy, is this going to be a problem or not?
Not at all, Mr. Peterson. I'm pulling it up now. And just so I can note it correctly, what specifically is the issue with the shoes?
They don't work. The fit is terrible, and I'm getting bad blisters after every ride. I just want a refund.

I'm sorry to hear that the fit is causing blisters. Let me just check the delivery date here... okay. I see you received the order 64 days ago, which is well within our 90-day return policy for standard items. I'm approving this for you right now.
Good. So you're sending the label?

Yes, absolutely. The return label is on its way to your email. Just a quick reminder, please be sure to remove your personal cleats before you pack up the cycling shoes for shipping. Once our warehouse receives the item, we will process your full refund to the original payment method.
Okay, fine. I've got the email. Thanks.
You're very welcome. Is there anything else I can assist you with today, Mr. Peterson?
Alright. Thank you for calling VeloFit. Have a great day.
